//: Only needed if you host the frontend on Vercel and the .NET API somewhere else. If you deploy the
Dockerfile instead, the API serves the SPA itself and this file is dead weight — delete it.
This sits at the repo root deliberately. The root has no package.json, so Vercel's own install step
is stubbed out and the build reaches into frontend/ itself. That means Root Directory, Framework
and Output Directory need no setting in the dashboard: the repo describes its own build.
BEFORE DEPLOYING: replace YOUR-API-HOST below with the host running the .NET API. All four rewrites
matter and the order is load-bearing — Vercel takes the first match, so the catch-all has to be
last or it would swallow the API calls too.
installCommand: echo 'nothing to install at the root'
buildCommand: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
